observations: Two large upright forms dominate the center and right, outlined in black with interiors filled by overlapping vertical streaks of yellow, green, blue, magenta, and orange against a flat pink background.
A smaller fragmented cluster in the upper left includes a rectangular frame, a wedge of white zigzag lines, and small red circular marks that also recur across the two main forms.
A loose grid of thin yellow and pink lines crosses the pink background, and a gray shadow falls beneath each major form, giving them weight on an otherwise flat plane.
reading: Two blocky upright forms stand side by side, their surfaces layered with competing vertical color streaks that read as both structure and noise. Small red circular marks recur across the forms without resolving into a clear subject. Gray shadows anchor each form to an implied ground, while the background grid keeps the image from settling into depth. The overall effect feels crowded and slightly off-balance.
